# `bin/model/` — the catalogue, the resolver and the rail

**Generated by `bin/gates/inventory.sh`. Do not hand-edit; do not commit it.** This file is
BUILT, never versioned (plan 243 part A, 2026-11-11) — it is ignored by git and rebuilt by an
install, an update, the session start (cached) and on demand, so no branch ever conflicts on it
and no stale copy on main can refuse a push for drift the pusher did not cause. The ward
judges the SOURCES (`bin/gates/inventory.sh --check`), never a committed copy.

**Read the columns.** `verdict` is measured, not judged: `tested` = a test
exercises it · `wired` = a skill, doc or gate names it · `internal` = only other
doors call it · `orphan` = nothing outside `bin/` names it · `provenance` = a
vendored `fm-*` script kept byte-comparable to upstream on purpose.
`disposition` says what happens to it: `keep`, `migrate → src/…` where the
Python runtime already has the module, `retire` for orphans, `provenance`.
